briefdescription.para: Return true if we know that it is safe to sink the load out of the block that defines it.

detaileddescription.para: This means that it must be obvious the value of the load is not changed from the point of the load to the end of the block it is in.
Finally, it is safe, but not profitable, to sink a load targeting a non-address-taken alloca. Doing so will cause us to not promote the alloca to a register.

briefdescription.para: Return true if this phi node is always equal to NonPhiInVal.

detaileddescription.para: This happens with mutually cyclic phi nodes like: z = some value; x = phi (y, z); y = phi (x, z)

briefdescription.para: Return an existing non-zero constant if this phi node has one, otherwise return constant 1.
